changes.Product: Seasoned sheep sausage meat (chair à saucisse de brebis assaisonnée)
changes.Reason: Non-compliant microbiological analysis; Listeria monocytogenes and Salmonella spp. named as the risks

proposals.reason: Product and Reason were French (standing English-output rule). Company set to the distributor the fiche names (Distributeurs: SCIC BIO A PRO uniquement), as the register did today for fiche 24041 (Company Houra, Brand Alnatura); the brand LA FERME DES ROBINS stays in Brand. The fiche's Risques encourus names BOTH Listeria monocytogenes and Salmonella spp; the row named only the first. Read on the fiche 2026-11-10.
